_doc: Pre-prompts of Mila Draw AI. kinds: what to draw without a picture. actions: what to do with attached pictures. tags go to tag models (illustrious, anima), text to FLUX; <ref_image_0>, <ref_image_1>... are the attached pictures in FLUX edit mode. negative: only for models where the negative works. denoise: how much img2img changes the first picture (tag models). references: the action needs a model that takes reference images. model: the model the page switches to when the action is chosen (the user can change it). size: key of sizes; for actions without size the result keeps the picture's proportions. The page shows what each preset adds. No project or story context here.

kinds.title: Фон
kinds.text: A scenery illustration with no people.

actions.title: Чистовой скетч
actions.tags: sketch, monochrome, greyscale, lineart, clean lines
actions.text: Redraw the rough sketch from <ref_image_0> as a clean, finished sketch: confident clean lines, refined details, corrected anatomy and proportions. Keep the same pose, composition and character design. Monochrome pencil lines on white paper.
actions.negative: color, messy lines, bad anatomy, bad hands

actions.title: Раскрасить
actions.text: Color the line art from <ref_image_0>: turn it into a finished full-color illustration with clean lineart, flat colors and soft cel shading. Keep the exact pose, character design and every detail of the drawing.

actions.title: Закончить иллюстрацию
actions.text: Finish the colored sketch from <ref_image_0> into a complete illustration: clean lineart, refined details, full shading and lighting. Keep the same pose, composition, colors and character design.
actions.negative: sketch, rough lines, flat color, bad anatomy

actions.title: Добавить рендер
actions.tags: highly detailed, shiny, rim lighting, sparkle, light particles
actions.text: Polish the illustration from <ref_image_0>: richer rendering, glossy highlights, rim light, small decorative details and sparkles. Keep the same composition, character and colors.

actions.title: Персонаж по референсам
actions.text: Create one original anime-style character that combines the key features of the reference images: appearance, outfit, colors and details. Full body, standing.

actions.title: Дизайн по фото
actions.text: Design an original anime-style character inspired by the reference photo <ref_image_0>: carry its shapes, colors, materials and mood into the character's look. Full body character design.
